requirement_text: Further details regarding HV-Interface in agreement with the client.
rationale: The sentence only says details are to be agreed with the client.
clarification_questions: Which details of the HV-Interface are to be agreed?
What must the system do beyond agreeing details with the client?

requirement_text: The BE system shall be able to ensure the secure delivery of all internal messages.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the BE system to deliver all internal messages securely, so that messages are not exposed or changed.
technical_task: Secure the delivery of every internal message in the BE system.
acceptance_criteria: Given an internal message, when the BE system delivers it, then the delivery is secure.
Given an unauthorized party on the delivery path, when it tries to read or alter a message, then it cannot.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The security mechanism is not specified.

requirement_text: The MultiMahjongClient will have a graphical user interface that the user will be able to interact with using a mouse and a keyboard.
user_story: As a player, I want a graphical user interface I can use with a mouse and a keyboard, so that I can play comfortably.
technical_task: Provide the MultiMahjongClient with a graphical user interface operable by mouse and keyboard.
acceptance_criteria: Given the MultiMahjongClient, when the user starts it, then a graphical user interface is displayed.
Given the graphical user interface, when the user interacts with it, then both a mouse and a keyboard can be used.

requirement_text: The system shall allow members to specify their role (Practitioner, Trainer, etc.).
user_story: As a member, I want to specify my role, such as Practitioner or Trainer, so that my profile shows what I do.
technical_task: Add a role selection to member profiles with options including Practitioner and Trainer.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member profile, when the member specifies a role, then the role is saved.
Given the role selection, when the member opens it, then roles such as Practitioner and Trainer are offered.
rationale: Role stated: member. "Etc." means other roles may exist.

requirement_text: If the vehicle possesses a variable partition window, InCarCom is active when the partition window is not closed.
user_story: As a passenger, I want InCarCom active when the partition window is not closed in a vehicle that has a variable partition window, so that communication works when the window is open.
technical_task: Keep InCarCom active whenever the variable partition window is not closed.
acceptance_criteria: Given a vehicle with a variable partition window that is not closed, when InCarCom is used, then it is active.
Given a vehicle without a variable partition window, when InCarCom is used, then this requirement does not apply.

requirement_text: The login interface shall include a "Forgot Password?" link.
user_story: As a user who forgot my password, I want a Forgot Password? link on the login page, so that I can recover my account.
technical_task: Add a "Forgot Password?" link to the login interface.
acceptance_criteria: Given the login interface, when it is displayed, then it includes a "Forgot Password?" link.
Given the link, when the user selects it, then the password recovery starts.
rationale: Role assumed: user who forgot the password. What happens after selecting the link is an assumption.

requirement_text: The system shall allow indicating relationships between collections and objects.
user_story: As an archivist, I want to indicate relationships between collections and objects, so that related items are linked.
technical_task: Provide a way to record a relationship between a collection and an object.
acceptance_criteria: Given a collection and an object, when the user indicates a relationship between them, then it is saved.
Given a saved relationship, when the collection or object is viewed, then the relationship is shown.

requirement_text: The overall accuracy shall be calculated by dividing total number of correct answers by the number of questions asked.
user_story: As a student, I want the overall accuracy calculated as the number of correct answers divided by the number of questions asked, so that I know my score.
technical_task: Compute overall accuracy as total correct answers divided by the number of questions asked.
acceptance_criteria: Given a set of questions asked and the correct answers among them, when accuracy is calculated, then it equals the total number of correct answers divided by the number of questions asked.
Given no correct answers, when accuracy is calculated, then the result is zero.

requirement_text: The rubber bowl may need to be modified from it's original hole diameter to seal around the CCPL socket that is larger in diameter than the fuel filler tube.
rationale: "May need to be modified" states a possibility, not a requirement, and gives no dimensions.
clarification_questions: Is the modification of the rubber bowl required or only possible?
What hole diameter must the rubber bowl have to seal around the CCPL socket?

requirement_text: The platform shall offer embedded visualization color customization.
user_story: As an analyst, I want to customize the colors of embedded visualizations, so that they match my needs.
technical_task: Offer color customization for visualizations embedded in the platform.
acceptance_criteria: Given an embedded visualization, when the user changes its colors, then the new colors are applied.
Given a customized visualization, when it is displayed again, then the chosen colors are kept.

requirement_text: The iTrust user (LCHP) has been authenticated in the iTrust Medical Records system (UC3).
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to be authenticated in the iTrust Medical Records system, so that I can use it (UC3).
technical_task: Require the LHCP to be authenticated in the iTrust Medical Records system before use.
acceptance_criteria: Given an LHCP with valid credentials, when the LHCP logs in, then the LHCP is authenticated.
Given an LHCP without valid credentials, when the LHCP logs in, then authentication fails.
rationale: Role stated: LHCP. The sentence states a precondition of use case UC3.

requirement_text: The user shall be able to add or make changes to the Subject Name.
user_story: As a user, I want to add or change the Subject Name, so that subjects are labelled correctly.
technical_task: Allow the Subject Name to be entered and edited.
acceptance_criteria: Given a subject, when the user adds a Subject Name, then it is saved.
Given a subject with a Subject Name, when the user changes it, then the new name is saved.

requirement_text: Recent jobs shall be displayed on the homepage.
user_story: As a job seeker, I want recent jobs shown on the homepage, so that I see new openings first.
technical_task: Display recent jobs on the homepage.
acceptance_criteria: Given recently posted jobs, when the homepage is displayed, then they are shown.
Given a job that is no longer recent, when the homepage is displayed, then it is not among the recent jobs.
rationale: Role assumed: job seeker. What counts as recent is not stated.

requirement_text: System shall provide CRUD functionality for archival descriptions.
user_story: As an archivist, I want create, read, update and delete functions for archival descriptions, so that I can maintain them.
technical_task: Implement CRUD operations for archival descriptions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new archival description, when the user creates it, then it is saved and can be read.
Given an existing archival description, when the user updates or deletes it, then the change is applied.

requirement_text: The Article Manager will run on the editor's PC and will utilize an Access database.
user_story: As an editor, I want the Article Manager to run on my PC and use an Access database, so that I can manage articles locally.
technical_task: Run the Article Manager on the editor's PC with an Access database.
acceptance_criteria: Given the editor's PC, when the Article Manager is started, then it runs on it.
Given the Article Manager, when it stores or reads data, then it uses an Access database.

requirement_text: The solution should encrypt and decrypt EMR data that is exchanged over a non-secure link.
user_story: As a security officer, I want EMR data encrypted and decrypted when it is exchanged over a non-secure link, so that it cannot be read in transit.
technical_task: Encrypt EMR data before sending it over a non-secure link and decrypt it on receipt.
acceptance_criteria: Given EMR data to be sent over a non-secure link, when it is sent, then it is encrypted.
Given encrypted EMR data received over a non-secure link, when it arrives, then it is decrypted.

requirement_text: The solution should provide audit capabilities indicating the time stamp for an object or data exchange.
user_story: As an auditor, I want audit capabilities that show the time stamp of each object or data exchange, so that exchanges can be traced.
technical_task: Record a time stamp for every exchange of an object or data.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object or data exchange, when it takes place, then an audit record with a time stamp is created.
Given the audit records, when an auditor opens them, then the time stamp of each exchange is visible.

requirement_text: System shall execute recipe searches and recommendations swiftly to enhance performance and user experience.
clarification_questions: How fast must recipe searches and recommendations be (what response time)?
What counts as enhanced user experience?

requirement_text: The solution should support a user-friendly output version of the audit log for transmission printing or export which shows all details of events.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should support a user-friendly output version of the audit log for transmission  printing  or export  which shows all details of events.
rationale: "User-friendly" is subjective and the output formats are not named.
clarification_questions: What makes the audit log output "user-friendly"?
Which details of events must be shown, and in what print or export formats?

requirement_text: The system shall achieve 95% up time.
requirement_text_raw: The system shall achieve 95\% up time.'
user_story: As a user, I want the system to be up 95% of the time, so that I can rely on it.
technical_task: Reach 95% up time.
acceptance_criteria: Given a measurement period, when up time is calculated, then it is at least 95%.
Given up time below 95%, when it is calculated, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The measurement period is not given.

requirement_text: System shall be able to search for a certain POI on the campus of the TU/e by name.
user_story: As a visitor, I want to search for a point of interest on the TU/e campus by name, so that I can find it.
technical_task: Offer a search of points of interest on the TU/e campus by name.
acceptance_criteria: Given the name of a point of interest on the TU/e campus, when the user searches, then the point of interest is found.
Given a name that matches no point of interest, when the user searches, then no result is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: visitor. POI is read as point of interest.

requirement_text: In the Twitter settings menu, the user shall be able to save their username and password for Twitter.
user_story: As a user, I want to save my Twitter username and password in the Twitter settings menu, so that I don't have to enter them each time.
technical_task: Add fields in the Twitter settings menu for saving the Twitter username and password.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Twitter settings menu, when the user enters and saves a username and password, then they are stored.
Given saved credentials, when the user opens the Twitter app again, then they are available.

requirement_text: The position sensor rotor is developed by the customer. The details of the position sensor rotor and the tolerance design between the positions sensor carrier and the position sensor rotor is designed by the customer.
user_story: As a project manager, I want the customer to develop the position sensor rotor and design its details and the tolerance to the position sensor carrier, so that responsibility is clear.
technical_task: Assign to the customer the development of the position sensor rotor and the design of its details and of the tolerance between the position sensor carrier and rotor.
acceptance_criteria: Given the position sensor rotor, when it is delivered, then it was developed by the customer.
Given the details of the rotor and the tolerance design between the carrier and the rotor, when they are delivered, then they were designed by the customer.

requirement_text: Access shall be granted if the credentials are valid; otherwise, access shall be denied.
user_story: As a user, I want access granted only when my credentials are valid, so that unauthorized people stay out.
technical_task: Grant access for valid credentials and deny it otherwise.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid credentials, when the user requests access, then access is granted.
Given invalid credentials, when the user requests access, then access is denied.

requirement_text: System shall allow browsing collections and viewing metadata.
user_story: As a researcher, I want to browse collections and view metadata, so that I can explore what is held.
technical_task: Provide collection browsing and a metadata view.
acceptance_criteria: Given collections, when the user browses, then the collections are listed.
Given a collection or object, when the user opens it, then its metadata is displayed.

requirement_text: System shall calculate modification charges based on modifying time, date, route, availability, display new fares, and process payments through the payment gateway.
user_story: As a passenger, I want modification charges calculated from the new time, date, route and availability, with new fares shown and payment processed through the payment gateway, so that I can change my booking.
technical_task: Calculate modification charges from modifying time, date, route and availability, show the new fares and process the payment through the payment gateway.
acceptance_criteria: Given a booking modification, when the user submits the changes, then modification charges are calculated from the time, date, route and availability.
Given calculated charges, when they are displayed, then new fares are shown and payment can be processed through the payment gateway.
rationale: Role assumed: passenger. The charge formula is not given.

requirement_text: System shall verify account authorization and initiate transaction dialog upon acceptance.
user_story: As a customer, I want my account authorization verified and a transaction dialog started when it is accepted, so that I can carry out the transaction.
technical_task: Verify account authorization and open the transaction dialog once authorization is accepted.
acceptance_criteria: Given an account that is authorized, when the system verifies it, then the transaction dialog is initiated.
Given an account that is not authorized, when the system verifies it, then no transaction dialog is initiated.

requirement_text: The user shall easily locate instructions while using the product. User help can be found within 90% of the system.
requirement_text_raw: The user shall easily locate instructions while using the product.  User help can be found within 90\% of the system.'
user_story: As a user, I want to find instructions easily, with user help available in 90% of the system, so that I get guidance when needed.
technical_task: Provide user help in at least 90% of the system and make instructions easy to locate.
acceptance_criteria: Given the parts of the system, when help availability is checked, then user help can be found within 90% of them.
Given a user who looks for instructions, when the user uses the product, then the instructions can be located.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Easily" is not measured; the 90% figure is the testable part.

requirement_text: System shall match the player with another player upon selection of the play icon.
user_story: As a player, I want to be matched with another player when I select the play icon, so that I can start a game.
technical_task: Match the player with another player when the play icon is selected.
acceptance_criteria: Given a player selects the play icon, when another player is available, then the two players are matched.
Given a player selects the play icon, when no other player is available, then the player waits for a match.
rationale: Role assumed: player. The waiting behaviour is an assumption.

requirement_text: User shall/will benefit from regular automated backups of the database and system configuration.
user_story: As an administrator, I want regular automated backups of the database and system configuration, so that I can restore them if needed.
technical_task: Schedule automated backups of the database and the system configuration.
acceptance_criteria: Given the backup schedule, when it is due, then the database is backed up automatically.
Given the backup schedule, when it is due, then the system configuration is backed up automatically.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. "Regularly" is not quantified.

requirement_text: Enter the appropriate information and click 'Save Form' to return to the Encounter summary page.
user_story: As a clinician, I want to enter the appropriate information and click Save Form to return to the Encounter summary page, so that my entry is saved.
technical_task: Add a Save Form button that saves the form and returns to the Encounter summary page.
acceptance_criteria: Given a completed form, when the user clicks Save Form, then the information is saved.
Given the information is saved, when the save completes, then the Encounter summary page is displayed.

requirement_text: Assign a unique name possibly and possibly number for identifying and tracking user identity and establish controls that permit only authorized users to access electronic health information.
user_story: As a security officer, I want a unique name, and possibly a number, to identify and track each user, with controls that let only authorized users access electronic health information, so that access is traceable.
technical_task: Assign each user a unique name and optionally a number for identification and tracking, and enforce controls that allow only authorized users to access electronic health information.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user, when an account is created, then a unique name is assigned.
Given a user who is not authorized, when the user tries to access electronic health information, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. "Possibly" makes the number optional.

requirement_text: The user can register attendance for the day by entering their Staff ID, name, and password and clicking the Register Attendance button.
user_story: As an employee, I want to register my attendance for the day by entering my Staff ID, name and password and clicking Register Attendance, so that my presence is recorded.
technical_task: Provide an attendance form with Staff ID, name and password fields and a Register Attendance button.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid Staff ID, name and password, when the user clicks Register Attendance, then attendance for the day is recorded.
Given invalid details, when the user clicks Register Attendance, then attendance is not recorded.

requirement_text: The FTPP shall be capable of restoring a corrected faulty computer into the flight critical computer set.
requirement_text_raw: The FTPP shall (3.1.12) be capable of restoring a corrected faulty computer into the flight critical computer set.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTPP to restore a corrected faulty computer into the flight critical computer set, so that redundancy is regained.
technical_task: Support restoring a computer that was faulty and has been corrected into the flight critical computer set.
acceptance_criteria: Given a faulty computer that has been corrected, when the FTPP restores it, then it is part of the flight critical computer set again.
Given a computer that has not been corrected, when the FTPP checks it, then it is not restored.

requirement_text: The user shall choose their desired alarm tone.
user_story: As a user, I want to choose my alarm tone, so that the alarm sounds the way I like.
technical_task: Offer a choice of alarm tones.
acceptance_criteria: Given the alarm settings, when the user chooses a tone, then it is saved.
Given a chosen alarm tone, when the alarm goes off, then that tone is played.

requirement_text: Note: This is a special requirement for start up, SCC needs to process the corresponding callback events in all other states as well.
rationale: The sentence is labelled "Note" and refers to context ("special requirement for start up") that is not given.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a note?
Which callback events must SCC process in all other states?

requirement_text: There shall be no data loss or loss of data integrity during share buying or selling transactions.
user_story: As an investor, I want no data loss or loss of data integrity during share buying or selling, so that my transactions are correct.
technical_task: Protect data and data integrity during share buying and selling transactions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a share buying transaction, when it completes, then no data is lost and data integrity is kept.
Given a share selling transaction, when it completes, then no data is lost and data integrity is kept.

requirement_text: System shall safely transfer money to the seller's bank account after successful transactions.
user_story: As a seller, I want the money transferred to my bank account after a successful transaction, so that I get paid.
technical_task: Transfer the money to the seller's bank account after each successful transaction.
acceptance_criteria: Given a successful transaction, when it completes, then the money is transferred to the seller's bank account.
Given an unsuccessful transaction, when it ends, then no money is transferred to the seller.
rationale: Role assumed: seller. The second criterion follows from "after successful transactions".

requirement_text: The server shall be capable of supporting an arbitrary number of active orders, meaning no orders shall be lost under any circumstances.
user_story: As a restaurant owner, I want the server to support any number of active orders without losing one, so that no order is missed.
technical_task: Design the server to hold any number of active orders and never lose an order.
acceptance_criteria: Given a large number of active orders, when they are submitted, then the server holds all of them.
Given a failure, when it occurs while orders are active, then no order is lost.
rationale: Role assumed: restaurant owner. "Arbitrary number" and "under any circumstances" cannot be proven; the criteria describe them as far as testable.

requirement_text: User shall be able to access project proposal references from the DMP.
user_story: As a researcher, I want to access project proposal references from the DMP, so that I can see the proposal behind a plan.
technical_task: Link project proposal references from the DMP.
acceptance_criteria: Given a DMP, when the user opens it, then project proposal references are available.
Given a project proposal reference, when the user selects it, then it can be accessed.

requirement_text: User shall be able to check their bank account balance before making a transaction.
user_story: As a customer, I want to check my bank account balance before making a transaction, so that I know I have enough.
technical_task: Show the account balance before a transaction is made.
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer who is about to make a transaction, when the customer checks the balance, then the account balance is shown.
Given a changed balance, when the customer checks it again, then the new balance is shown.

requirement_text: User shall be able to view a list of 360° videos after selecting the "Videos" option.
user_story: As a viewer, I want to see a list of 360° videos after selecting Videos, so that I can pick one to watch.
technical_task: Show a list of 360° videos when the Videos option is selected.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Videos option, when the user selects it, then a list of 360° videos is shown.
Given the list, when the user selects a video, then it can be opened.
rationale: Role assumed: viewer. The degree symbol in the source is garbled and read as 360°.

requirement_text: If the game is not saved, a dialog box is displayed that asks to the player if he wants to save the game. Two choices are possible : "Yes" and "No". If "Yes" is selected, the action "Save" is processed and the main window disappeared. If "No" is selected, the main window disappeared.
user_story: As a player, I want to be asked whether to save the game when it is not saved, with Yes or No choices, so that I don't lose progress by mistake.
technical_task: Show a save dialog with Yes and No when the game is not saved: on Yes, save and close the main window; on No, close the main window.
acceptance_criteria: Given the game is not saved, when the player leaves, then a dialog box asks whether to save the game with the two choices "Yes" and "No".
Given the dialog box, when "Yes" is selected, then the action "Save" is processed and the main window disappears, and when "No" is selected, then the main window disappears.

requirement_text: The number of menus and the hierarchical structure depends strongly on the number of features requested (for more details, see feature requests in this document).
rationale: The sentence states a dependency between menus and features without specifying behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or an observation?
What must the menus provide and how many features are requested?

requirement_text: The supplier is responsible for closing all open interfaces resulting from the removing of functions in the supplier software.
user_story: As a client, I want the supplier to close all open interfaces left by removing functions from the supplier software, so that no loose interfaces remain.
technical_task: Make the supplier close every interface left open by the removal of functions in the supplier software.
acceptance_criteria: Given a function removed from the supplier software, when its interfaces are reviewed, then no open interface from it remains.
Given the supplier software after removals, when it is delivered, then all resulting open interfaces are closed.

requirement_text: The website shall utilize HTTPS protocol to enhance security during data transmission.
user_story: As a user, I want the website to use HTTPS, so that my data is protected in transit.
technical_task: Serve the website over the HTTPS protocol.
acceptance_criteria: Given the website, when a user opens it, then the connection uses HTTPS.
Given data sent by a user, when it is transmitted, then it is sent over HTTPS.

requirement_text: A Data Consuming User shall be able to download view state images.
user_story: As a data consumer, I want to download view state images, so that I can use them offline.
technical_task: Provide a download for view state images.
acceptance_criteria: Given a view state image, when the Data Consuming User selects download, then the image is downloaded.
Given a downloaded view state image, when it is opened, then it shows the view state.

requirement_text: After the journey, users shall receive a feedback form to provide feedback based on their journey experience.
user_story: As a traveler, I want a feedback form after my journey, so that I can describe my experience.
technical_task: Send a feedback form to users after each journey.
acceptance_criteria: Given a journey has ended, when it is finished, then the user receives a feedback form.
Given a feedback form, when the user submits it, then the feedback about the journey experience is saved.

requirement_text: An HCP is able to create a patient or disable a selected patient .
requirement_text_raw: An HCP is able to create a patient  or disable a selected patient .
user_story: As an HCP, I want to create a patient or disable a selected patient, so that records are kept current.
technical_task: Offer functions to create a patient and to disable a selected patient.
acceptance_criteria: Given the HCP enters patient details, when the HCP creates the patient, then the patient is saved.
Given a selected patient, when the HCP disables the patient, then the patient is disabled.

requirement_text: V Mart shall handle expected and unexpected errors to prevent loss of information and minimize downtime.
user_story: As a customer, I want V Mart to handle expected and unexpected errors, so that information is not lost and downtime is minimized.
technical_task: Handle expected and unexpected errors in V Mart in a way that prevents loss of information.
acceptance_criteria: Given an expected error occurs, when V Mart handles it, then no information is lost.
Given an unexpected error occurs, when V Mart handles it, then no information is lost and downtime is kept as short as possible.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. How much downtime is acceptable is not stated.
